name: Original self-calibrated RGB reconstruction
initialization: Fine-tuned from our original v1 RGB checkpoint, which was trained from random initialization. No external pretrained weights or external teacher outputs.
runtime: Browser-only ONNX Runtime Web, single-threaded WASM.
method: One paired factual/counterfactual inference round; only the uncertain calibrated contour may change. Inverted core pixels and verified original-frame motion contributions are preserved.
training: 768 paired synthetic-overlay inputs from unmarked areas of the user-supplied video; clean source targets. Frame interval 83–127 held out for 192 validation pairs.
limitations: One-video research model for small calibrated translucent white marks. Visible reconstruction traces remain possible. Not a universal or guaranteed invisible-removal model.

controlledSequence.note: Related one-video synthetic-overlay experiment, not hidden ground truth for the actual marked clip.

uncertainFramePolicy: In motion/reconstruction mode, strong absence evidence preserves source pixels; otherwise rejected calibrated frames use estimation confined to the calibrated fixed-mark support. This does not guarantee invisible removal.

compressedSequence.model: Same retained v3 graph in both comparisons
compressedSequence.note: Related one-video synthetic control; not actual hidden-ground-truth accuracy.

fineMotionComparison.note: Small improvement on the related raw control and near-zero, slightly worse compressed-control scores. Does not resolve actual visible patches.
